title: Restless Sleep
prompt: Paul comes home tired. He goes to his room and turns off the light to sleep. After a while, feeling uneasy, he turns the light on and looks around. He turns it off again and tries to sleep. After repeating this several times, he looks under his bed and finds a dead body.
solution: A thief was robbing Paul's home. When Paul arrived, the thief hid under the bed. The tension became too much for him and he suffered a sudden heart attack and died. Paul couldn't sleep because of the ticking of the dead thief's wristwatch.
